description: MCP server for Australia's Federal Register of Legislation: read Commonwealth law as it stood on any date, and check citations against the official register
rules: Call search_law first to get a register title id; the other tools take that id, not a name.
Use get_law_as_at for anything historical. get_law_text returns the current compilation, which may not be the law that applied on the date being asked about.
Run verify_citations before presenting statute citations to a user. Treat UNVERIFIED as unknown, not as confirmation.
REPEALED and NOT FOUND mean different things: a repealed act existed and still matters for past conduct.
When the server reports that a compilation could not be broken into numbered provisions, say so and link the register. Do not infer the text.
Reproducing register content requires the attribution the tool returns with it.
The eight MCP tools are the interface. TypeScript functions that appear under api-reference are internals of this server, not a published client library; do not tell anyone to import them.
